units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 4:4">Ber. IV, 4</cite> (in a short prayer prescribed for one passing an unsafe road) … <he>בכל פ׳ הע׳ לפניך</he> let their needs be before thee at every critical period, expl.

<cite ref="Berakhot 29b">ib. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ … ע̇ב̇ר̇ה כאשה עו̇ב̇ר̇ת וכ׳</he> even at a moment when thou art full of swelling anger at them, like a woman big with child &c.; (anoth. explan.) <he>אפי׳ … ע̇יב̇ר̇ים על דברי תורה</he> even at a moment when they trespass the words of the Law; Y. ib. IV, 8ᵇ top <he>כל מה שש״ץ ע̇וב̇ר̇ וכ׳</he> whatever the messenger of the congregation passing before the ark may ask of thee &c.

senses.gloss: ע׳ דִּין passing beyond justice or law, rigor, tyranny.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:16">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>ע׳ הדין שעיבר על אחרים</he> the rigorous judgment which he passed on others.
Gen. R. s. 94 (ref. to Gen. XLV, 23) בר ע׳ bâr means breadstuff.
<cite ref="Ketubot 112a:11">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>ממנה ע׳ וכ׳</he> from this field I have my breadstuff, from it my peas &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>) <he>עצבונך זה צער הע׳</he> ‘thy pain’ refers to the suffering attending upon conception, v. <cite ref="P00506"><he>עִידּוּי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 100b:21">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>והרונך זה צער הע׳</he> ‘and thy pregnancy’ refers to &c.; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I. Gen. R. s. 51</cite><cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51">Gen. R. s. 51</cite>, end (play on <he>עברתו</he>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 48:30">Jer. XLVIII, 30</cite>) <he>מתחילת עִיבּוּרוֹ וכ׳</he> from the time when Moab was first conceived.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite>, end <he>שנה לעִיבּוּרָהּ של וכ׳</he> deduct one year for the pregnancy with Milkah &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Ib.</cite> s. 45, beg. (expl. <he>מכרה</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 31:10">Prov. XXXI, 10</cite>) <he>עִיבּוּרָהּ</he> her going with child (with allusion to <he>מכרתיך</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 16:3">Ez. XVI, 3</cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: extension of city limits for Sabbath movements, outskirts.
units: Erub. V, 7 … הנותן בעיבורה של עיר he who places his ‘Erub within the outskirts of a city. Y. ib. 22ᵇ bot. מהו ליתן ע׳ לע׳ may an outskirt be added to an outskirt (to be considered part of the township)?; a. fr.—6) intercalation; ע׳ החדש proclaiming the month just past one of thirty days; ע׳ השנה proclaiming a leap-year, inserting a second Adar.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:1">Snh. I, 1</cite> <he>ע׳ החדש בשלשה</he> the proclamation of a full month (i.e. the postponement of the New Moon Day) must take place in a court of three.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11a:13">Ib. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ השנה שלשים יום</he> the intercalated month consists of thirty days.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 12a:8">Ib. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>כנגד חדש הע׳</he> corresponding to the thirteenth month.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:8">B. Mets. VIII, 8</cite> <he>יחלוקי את חדש הע׳</he> let them (the landlord and the tenant) divide the rent for the additional month; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עִיבּוּרִים</he>, <he>עִיבּוּרִין</he>, <cite ref="P00491"><he>עִבּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 7a:13">R. Hash. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>באחד בניסן … ולע׳</he> the first of Nisan is the New Year’s Day for the months and for intercalations; expl.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 7a:13">ib.</cite> <he>להפסקת ע׳</he> for interrupting the intercalation, i.e. after the month of Nisan has been proclaimed, no intercalation can take place for that year.
Gen. R. s. 72 (expl. לעתים, I Chr. XII, 33) לע׳ ‘for seasons’ means for intercalations; a. fr.—Trnsf. calculations of the time of redemption (v. קֵץ); epochs.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:8:1">Cant. R. to II, 8</cite> <he>מדלג על החשבונות ועל הקיצים וע׳</he> the Lord skips over (human) calculations and (speculations on) ends and epochs; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 986:2">Yalk. Cant. 986</cite>.

Lev. R. s. 19 אנו … כמה קצים וכמה ע׳ we who have been separated from the house of our life and from the house of our holiness and glory these many days and years, these many terms and epochs; Yalk. ib. 571 כמה יובלות וכמה ע׳.—7) ע׳ צורה (v. עָבַר Pu.) disfiguration, decay.
